Sobre.title: Hi, I'm Mireile — but you can call me Mika
paragraphs: I'm a human development specialist. I believe growth doesn't have to be a serious, distant process — it can (and should) be warm, human and full of good energy, even when the subject hurts.

My work is helping people unlock their potential: building self-knowledge, emotional intelligence, communication and self-leadership. I combine the science of human behavior with practical tools to turn awareness into action — in daily life, in relationships and in their careers.
Today I bring this perspective to courses, protocols and corporate talks, helping people and teams grow with more awareness.
